# Replaces the history timeline on the About page with one consistent block. # The existing one is page content written by code that Apps > Import Module # never runs, so its entries carry different heading levels and markers. # Safe to run again: it looks for its own marker class first. NEW = """
Our History

Operating heritage since 1946

RBC Industrial — Founded 1946

Founded in El Paso, Texas by Roger Brown, Sr. after he returned from serving as a Navy engineering officer in the Second World War.

1946

RBC Industrial — Acquired by Liber Holdings

Liber Holdings acquired the Texas-based Roger Brown Co in El Paso, Texas, which was founded in 1946.

2016

Liber Industrial - Founded

Liber Industrial was formed in 2018 in Bulverde, Texas as a separate operating entity within the Liber Holdings group, originally to serve public-sector school-district supply programs while shielding the group's other entities from contract liability. That line has since closed. Liber Industrial today focuses on industrial MRO supply and specialty chemical distribution.

2018

Tooling Components - Acquired

Tooling Components, a distributor of mold, die and polishing supplies, was founded by Diane Bowes in 1983 near Erie, Pennsylvania.

2023

Globe Electric Supply - Investment

Liber Holdings and an individual investor purchased the stock of Globe Electric Supply Co Inc to grow our share of government infrastructure projects.

2024

RBC Industrial - Rebrand

RBC Industrial was formed as a rebrand of Roger Brown Co, with the same suppliers and the same team.

2025
""" MARKERS = ["RBC Industrial — Acquired by Liber Holdings", "Liber Industrial - Founded", "Globe Electric Supply - Investment", "Tooling Components Acquired"] Page = env["website.page"].sudo() pages = Page.search([("url", "in", ["/about-us", "/about", "/aboutus"])]) report = [] for page in pages: view = page.view_id if not view: continue arch = view.with_context(lang="en_US").arch_db or "" if "o_liber_timeline_section" in arch: report.append("%s: already rebuilt" % page.url) continue hit = -1 for marker in MARKERS: hit = arch.find(marker) if hit != -1: break if hit == -1: report.append("%s: no timeline found, left alone" % page.url) continue start = arch.rfind("", hit) if start == -1 or end == -1: report.append("%s: timeline boundaries unclear, left alone" % page.url) continue end = end + 10 view.write({"arch_db": arch[:start] + NEW + arch[end:]}) report.append("%s: timeline rebuilt with 6 entries" % page.url) env["ir.attachment"].sudo().search([("name", "like", "web.assets_frontend%")]).unlink() env.registry.clear_cache() action = { "type": "ir.actions.client", "tag": "display_notification", "params": {"title": "Liber history timeline", "type": "success", "sticky": True, "message": " | ".join(report) or "No About page found."}, }
